title: Don't order blue for a boy...
text: Don't order blue for a boy.... I ordered these "crocs" because they were cheap and I love caterpillars. I will admit that they are cute, but I ordered the blue for my son and when they FINALLY arrived, about 2 months later and a couple weeks after the latest expected delivery date, they are blue with pink feelers and a pink strap. My son is only 4 and wouldn't care, but people already think he's a girl with his curly hair, so his dad wouldn't let him wear these in public haha They are also huge, probably 2 sizes too big. So maybe next year they can be play shoes. The seller was also less than helpful.
